scripts.build:web: npm run build:web:app && npm run build:web:wasm && vite build products/micro-web-player
scripts.dev:web: npm run build:web:app && npm run build:web:wasm && vite products/micro-web-player --host 127.0.0.1
scripts.demo: npm run build:app && cargo run -p micro-host-sdl --features native -- --os apps/shell/dist/shell.mbc apps/counter/dist/counter.mbc apps/settings/dist/settings.mbc apps/momo/dist/momo.mbc
scripts.icon:generate: mkdir -p target/swift-module-cache target/tmp && TMPDIR="$PWD/target/tmp" swift -module-cache-path "$PWD/target/swift-module-cache" scripts/generate-app-icon.swift
scripts.test:web: npm run test:web:unit && npm run build:web && playwright test
